name: Integrated Optical Inspection Sorting & Packing Automation Line
shortDescription: Complete automated line for part feeding, optical inspection, sorting, and packing.
fullDescription: The Integrated Optical Inspection & Packing Automation Line combines automated part feeding, high-speed optical inspection, intelligent sorting, and automated packing into a single streamlined production system. The solution reduces manual handling, improves inspection accuracy, and increases production throughput. It supports PLC control, vision processing software, and seamless production line integration.
specs: Defect sorting and recheck bin handling
PLC and HMI based control system
Production data logging and reporting support

name: Automated Fluid Dispenser System
shortDescription: High-precision automated fluid dispensing for industrial processes.
fullDescription: The Automated Fluid Dispenser System is designed for accurate and repeatable dispensing of liquids in manufacturing environments. The system integrates PLC-based control, flow monitoring, and recipe management to ensure consistent output, reduced wastage, and improved process reliability.
specs: PLC-based batch controller with recipe management
Historical data logging and Report Generation

name: Industrial Tank Level Monitoring & Control System
shortDescription: Reliable monitoring and automation of industrial tank levels.
fullDescription: The Industrial Tank Level Monitoring & Control System provides continuous level measurement, automated pump and valve control, and alarm handling for safe and efficient tank operations. It supports local SCADA visualization and optional remote monitoring.
specs: Universal analog input support (4-20 mA / 0-10 V) for ultrasonic, radar, and pressure level sensors
High and low level alarm management

name: Vision-Based Product Inspection System
shortDescription: Automated visual inspection for quality assurance.
fullDescription: The Vision-Based Product Inspection System uses industrial cameras and intelligent image processing to detect defects, verify dimensions, and ensure product quality in real time. It improves inspection accuracy while reducing manual intervention and rejection costs.
